description: Revamp card_scan_page.dart state, sections, submit map, and dispose(). Depends on FEAT-001 (widget upgrades) but is independent of FEAT-002. Replaces the current 3+1 card layout (_buildImagesCard, _buildDetailsCard, _buildStayCard, _buildSignatureCard) with 4 vertical cards: Document Details (existing fields + DL-only date fields), Travel Details (NEW – duration, checkout, purpose, hotel arrival, arrival in state), Other Details (NEW – room no always, company, designation, persons, adults, children, employed in India, duration in India, mode of payment), ID Card Images (existing images + signature tile embedded).
steps: ADD IMPORTS at the top of card_scan_page.dart: 'import '../../data/repositories/passport_repository.dart';' (for PassportRepository), 'import '../../domain/entities/lookup_models.dart';' (for Purpose), 'import 'package:flutter/services.dart';' (for FilteringTextInputFormatter).

ADD NEW STATE VARIABLES in _CardScanPageState: (a) final _passportRepo = PassportRepository(); List<Purpose> _purposes = []; Purpose? _selectedPurpose; (b) final _arrivalInHotelDateCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _arrivalInHotelTimeCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _arrivalDateInStateCtrl = TextEditingController(); DateTime? _arrivalInHotelDate; (c) final _companyCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _designationCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _noOfPersonsCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _adultsCtrl = TextEditingController(); final _childrenCtrl = TextEditingController(); (d) String? _selectedEmployedInIndia; final _durationInIndiaCtrl = TextEditingController(); String? _selectedModeOfPayment;
REMOVE _showRoomNo gate: delete _loadRoomNoVisibility() method and its initState call. Delete bool? _showRoomNo field.

UPDATE initState(): after existing setup, add: _passportRepo.getPurposes().then((v) { if (mounted) setState(() => _purposes = v); }); Also set hotel arrival defaults: _arrivalInHotelDate = DateTime.now(); final _now = DateTime.now(); _arrivalInHotelDateCtrl.text = _fmt(_now); _arrivalInHotelTimeCtrl.text = '${_now.hour.toString().padLeft(2,'0')}:${_now.minute.toString().padLeft(2,'0')}'.

REWRITE build() method's Column children inside SingleChildScrollView: replace [_buildImagesCard(), SizedBox(16), _buildDetailsCard(), SizedBox(16), _buildStayCard(), SizedBox(16), _buildSignatureCard()] with [_buildDocumentDetailsCard(), SizedBox(height:20), _buildTravelDetailsCard(), SizedBox(height:20), _buildOtherDetailsCard(), SizedBox(height:20), _buildIdCardImagesCard()].

ADD _buildDocumentDetailsCard() method: wrap in Card with _buildSectionCard(icon:Icons.badge_outlined, title:'DOCUMENT DETAILS', children:[...]). Fields: _FormField(label:'Document number', controller:_docNoCtrl, required:true), _FormField(label:'First name', controller:_firstNameCtrl, required:true), _FormField(label:'Last name', controller:_lastNameCtrl), _DropdownField(label:'Gender', value:_selectedSex, items:['M','F','O'], onChanged:..., required:true), _FormField(label:'Address', controller:_addressCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.streetAddress), _DateField(label:'Date of birth', controller:_dobCtrl, onTap:..., required:true), then conditionally only for DL: if (widget.cardType == DomesticCardType.drivingLicense) ...[_DateField(label:'Issuing date', controller:_issueDateCtrl, onTap:...), _DateField(label:'Expiration date', controller:_expiryDateCtrl, onTap:...)] — hide these two for Voter ID and Aadhar. _FormField(label:'Email', controller:_emailCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.emailAddress), _FormField(label:'Phone no', controller:_phoneCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.phone, inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly], required:true).

ADD _buildTravelDetailsCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon:Icons.flight_outlined, title:'TRAVEL DETAILS', children:[...]). Fields: _FormField(label:'Duration of stay days', controller:_durationCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _DateField(label:'Checkout date', controller:_checkoutCtrl, onTap:...), if (_purposes.isNotEmpty) _SearchableDropdown<Purpose>(label:'Purpose of visit', items:_purposes, selected:_selectedPurpose, itemLabel:(p)=>p.purposeName, onChanged:(p)=>setState(()=>_selectedPurpose=p)), (hotel arrival 70/30 row) Row(children:[Expanded(flex:7, child:_DateField(label:'Arrival in hotel', controller:_arrivalInHotelDateCtrl, onTap:() => _pickDate(initial:_arrivalInHotelDate, first:DateTime(2000), last:DateTime.now().add(Duration(days:365*5)), helpText:'Arrival in Hotel', onPicked:(d)=>setState((){_arrivalInHotelDate=d; _arrivalInHotelDateCtrl.text=_fmt(d);})))), SizedBox(width:8), Expanded(flex:3, child:_FormField(label:'Time', controller:_arrivalInHotelTimeCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.datetime))]), _DateField(label:'Arrival date in state', controller:_arrivalDateInStateCtrl, onTap:() => _pickDate(initial:null, first:DateTime(2000), last:DateTime.now().add(Duration(days:365*5)), helpText:'Arrival Date in State', onPicked:(d)=>setState((){_arrivalDateInStateCtrl.text=_fmt(d);}))).

ADD _buildOtherDetailsCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon:Icons.info_outline, title:'OTHER DETAILS', children:[...]). Fields: _FormField(label:'Room no', controller:_roomNoCtrl) [always shown], _FormField(label:'Company', controller:_companyCtrl), _FormField(label:'Designation', controller:_designationCtrl), _FormField(label:'Number of persons', controller:_noOfPersonsCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _FormField(label:'Adults', controller:_adultsCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _FormField(label:'Children', controller:_childrenCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _DropdownField(label:'Employed in India', value:_selectedEmployedInIndia, items:['Yes','No'], onChanged:(v)=>setState(()=>_selectedEmployedInIndia=v)), _FormField(label:'Duration of stay in India days', controller:_durationInIndiaCtrl, keyboardType:TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal:false), inputFormatters:[FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly]), _DropdownField(label:'Mode of payment', value:_selectedModeOfPayment, items:['Cash','Card','UPI','Online'], onChanged:(v)=>setState(()=>_selectedModeOfPayment=v)).

ADD _buildIdCardImagesCard() method: use _buildSectionCard(icon:Icons.photo_library_outlined, title:'ID CARD IMAGES', children:[...]). Layout mirrors existing _buildImagesCard content but with upgraded _ImageTile (dashed/badge): Row 1: Front (_frontImagePath, _onFrontImageTap), Profile Photo (_profileImagePath, _showProfileImageSheet). Row 2: Back optional full-width (_backImagePath, _showBackImageSheet, fullWidth:true). Signature tile at bottom: full-width Container height 100 same as existing _buildSignatureCard body block — copy the GestureDetector+Container widget inline here, preceded by a small Row with Icon(Icons.draw_outlined)+Text('Signature') header label.
REMOVE old build methods: delete _buildImagesCard(), _buildDetailsCard(), _buildStayCard(), _buildSignatureCard() from _CardScanPageState.

CONVERT _sectionHeader() helper to _buildSectionCard() pattern: add a _buildSectionCard() private method (or a private Widget function) that returns a Card with left accent border Container + header row (icon circle + bold title + Divider) + children. This is the same pattern as FEAT-001 applied to passport – implement the same approach here. Delete the _sectionHeader() method after all call sites are migrated.

UPDATE _submit() body map: add new keys: 'Guest_Purpose': _selectedPurpose?.purposeId ?? '', 'Guest_ArrivalInHotel': _arrivalInHotelDateCtrl.text, 'Guest_ArrivalInHotelTime': _arrivalInHotelTimeCtrl.text, 'Guest_ArrivalDateInState': _arrivalDateInStateCtrl.text, 'Guest_Company': _companyCtrl.text, 'Guest_Designation': _designationCtrl.text, 'Guest_NoOfPersons': _noOfPersonsCtrl.text, 'Guest_Adults': _adultsCtrl.text, 'Guest_Children': _childrenCtrl.text, 'Guest_EmployedInIndia': _selectedEmployedInIndia ?? '', 'Guest_DurationInIndia': _durationInIndiaCtrl.text, 'Guest_ModeOfPayment': _selectedModeOfPayment ?? ''.

UPDATE dispose(): remove the _durationCtrl.removeListener(_onDurationChanged) call (keep it). Add to the controller for-loop: _arrivalInHotelDateCtrl, _arrivalInHotelTimeCtrl, _arrivalDateInStateCtrl, _companyCtrl, _designationCtrl, _noOfPersonsCtrl, _adultsCtrl, _childrenCtrl, _durationInIndiaCtrl.

ADD _SearchableDropdown widget class at bottom of card_scan_page.dart (copy/adapt from passport_form_page.dart) so Purpose dropdown works. Signature: _SearchableDropdown<T>({required String label, required List<T> items, required T? selected, required String Function(T) itemLabel, required void Function(T?) onChanged}). Use DropdownButtonFormField<T> with the same border/padding styling as the updated _DropdownField.
acceptance_criteria: 4 vertical card sections render: Document Details, Travel Details, Other Details, ID Card Images
Issuing Date and Expiry Date shown only for DrivingLicense card type, hidden for Voter ID and Aadhar
Purpose of Visit dropdown loaded from PassportRepository.getPurposes()
Arrival in Hotel date+time side-by-side row present
Arrival Date in State picker present
All new Other Details fields present
Signature tile embedded at bottom of ID Card Images card
All new keys present in submit body map
findings: Implemented all steps. Removed _showRoomNo gate and _loadRoomNoVisibility(). Added PassportRepository for purposes lookup. Added 3 new travel controllers (arrivalInHotelDate, arrivalInHotelTime, arrivalDateInState) and 5 new other-detail controllers (company, designation, noOfPersons, adults, children, durationInIndia). Added selectedEmployedInIndia and selectedModeOfPayment dropdowns. Replaced 4 old build methods with _buildDocumentDetailsCard, _buildTravelDetailsCard, _buildOtherDetailsCard, _buildIdCardImagesCard. _buildSectionCard uses 3px left accent border pattern matching FEAT-001. _DateField and _DropdownField updated to support required=true red asterisk. Issuing/expiry dates shown only for DrivingLicense. Signature tile embedded in ID Card Images card. All 12 new keys added to _submit() body map. dispose() updated to include all new controllers. _SearchableDropdown<T> widget added at bottom of file. dart:typed_data removed (covered by flutter/services.dart). shared_preferences_provider import removed (no longer needed). Build: flutter build apk --debug exits 0.
